title: Industrial Fire Trends and Spot Checks to Ensure Compliance to Safety Measures
what_it_is: Industrial Fire Trends and Spot Checks to Ensure Compliance to Safety Measures

sections.label: Prolonged SCDF fire operations
sections.summary: About five fires each year required prolonged operations by SCDF to put out.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Of these, about five each year required prolonged operations by SCDF to put out.

sections.label: Industrial fire safety inspections
sections.summary: SCDF conducted about 10,000 fire safety inspections yearly on industrial premises, taking enforcement action in about 3,200 cases each year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the past three years, SCDF conducted about 10,000 fire safety inspections each year on industrial premises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Enforcement action was taken in about 3,200 cases each year.

sections.label: Prosecutions of industrial premises
sections.summary: SCDF prosecuted about 30 industrial premises each year for very serious infringements or recalcitrant non-compliance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: SCDF also prosecuted about 30 industrial premises each year for very serious infringements or recalcitrant non-compliance.

sections.label: Fire safety manager appointment rules
sections.summary: Industrial premises with 1,000 or more occupants or 5,000 sqm or more must appoint a fire safety manager, covering over 85% today.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Industrial premises are required to appoint a fire safety manager (FSM) if they accommodate 1,000 or more occupants, or if their floor area is 5,000 square metres (sqm) or more.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Today, more than 85% of industrial premises are required to appoint an FSM.

sections.label: Company emergency response team requirements
sections.summary: Under the Fire Safety Act, certain industrial premises and petroleum-storing companies must form a CERT of at least six members.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Under the Fire Safety Act, all industrial premises that accommodate 1,000 or more occupants, or have a floor area of 5,000 sqm or more, and any company storing more than five metric tonnes of petroleum and flammable materials are required to form a company emergency response team (CERT).

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: To operate as a team, CERT comprises six members at the minimum.
